name: scp
summary: Copies files between machines over SSH.
description: Secure copy: works like cp, but one end (or both) can be remote, written user@host:path. The transfer is encrypted and uses the same authentication as ssh (password or key, aliases from ~/.ssh/config). For large transfers or repeated syncs, rsync is more efficient.

options.description: The server’s SSH port (uppercase, unlike ssh -p).

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: File(s) to copy: local path or user@host:path.

arguments.name: DESTINATION
arguments.description: Target location: local path or user@host:path.

examples.explanation: Sends a file to a remote machine.
Fetches a remote file into the current directory (“.”).
Sends a whole directory to an SSH server listening on port 2222.

dangerNote: scp overwrites existing files at the destination without confirmation.
